north_star: 持续提升 RCL 作为可执行现实语义中间语言/现实事务演算的通用性、可表达性、可执行性、可验证性与现实鲁棒性；候选现实不得绕过证据、权限、版本、4R 与现实验证边界。

observations.signal: The Perception Observe direct-lowering seam can emit canonical core RBC candidates, but RCL has no dedicated fail-closed verifier that binds the original reference semantics, lowered RBC execution, semantic state-root parity and native state-root authority into one reusable decision receipt.
Core state parity does not by itself prove Foundation domain-receipt/history parity, so the verifier must keep that claim outside its acceptance boundary instead of silently upgrading the evidence.
Whole-language native self-host closure remains bounded by Stage-0 host ownership.

ranked_candidates.problem: materialize a reusable fail-closed verifier that can only return native-verified when direct-lowered RBC matches reference semantic state and semantic state root and the C Native VM has authenticated its own state root
evidence: fail closed for missing native VM, compile blockage, execution failure and parity mismatch

ranked_candidates.problem: run the direct-lowered perception candidate on an actually materialized canonical C Native VM and record the resulting parity receipt
evidence: the current bounded validation workspace does not contain a materialized canonical Linux rclvm binary/full repository runtime
this cycle must not substitute a mocked runner for the actual C Native VM claim

ranked_candidates.problem: remove remaining Stage-0 host ownership from whole-language self-host closure

mode_reason: Native execution parity is now the dominant evidence gap, but an executable decision organ that refuses false parity claims is a prerequisite for trustworthy reality validation. Deepen this exact seam before expanding Foundation domain coverage.
behavioral_change: direct-lowered Foundation bytecode can be evaluated through one explicit parity verifier instead of ad-hoc checks
native-verified is non-compensatory: semantic state, semantic state root, native state-root verification and native state-root parity must all pass
missing C Native VM is reported as native-blocked and never promoted to a parity claim
compile blockage and native execution failure remain distinct fail-closed states
semantic state comparison removes native heap metadata through semanticValue before canonical comparison
history/domain receipt parity remains explicitly outside the verifier claim boundary
ci_policy: Every branch commit carries [skip ci] [skip actions]. Do not actively consume GitHub Actions; verify the branch head remains workflow-free before PR and verify the PR head remains workflow-free before merge.
truth_boundary: This cycle verifies the verifier organ itself, not Perception C Native VM parity. No native-verified claim is made for a real Perception program until the verifier runs against a materialized canonical C Native VM and returns native-verified. History/domain-receipt parity, all-Foundation native lowering and provider-bridge removal remain unclaimed.
